name: journey 06: read an array of records as a table, sort it and export it (columns, nested items, the detail, sort up and down, export to csv)

contains: #  id       status   customer  items  total  created_at  coupon?
sorted by total ↑ (a view: the document keeps its order)
wrote the export of the restructured document to

notes.note: opened as `o-json orders.min.json`; j onto .data, ctrl+w l into the table
4 l to the items column: the first order's items open below it as a sub-table
j to the second item, $ to its price, y p yanks its path
s i c sorts the table by the column, smallest first; a view, the document keeps its order
s s on the same column reverses it
j j j: the fourth biggest order
0 to the # column, enter opens the row in the detail
w with a .csv name exports the rows as shown (sorted) next to the source
:sort (Vim's ex word) on the # column clears the sort: the document's order is back
q quits: an export is not an edit, nothing to ask
